q: Why does mod-N remap nearly everything on node add?
a: Ownership is key mod N, so changing N reassigns almost every key.

q: How much moves adding a node to a consistent ring?
a: About 1/(N+1) of keys: the new node steals only its own arcs.
Many ring points per real node to even out slice sizes and avoid lumpy hot shards.

q: What do you watch after a topology change?
a: Per-node load: uneven arcs show up as accidental hot shards.
